subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'PLAYGROUND' is written as ‘OKZXFQNTMC’ and ‘SCIENCE’ is written as ‘RBHDMBD, how will 'TYPEWRITER' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

Logic: **Letters - 1.**

Here, for 'PLAYGROUND' is written as ‘OKZXFQNTMC’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10c9f7366d48698f0763dd6b191aa299e1dc34e02390fd91ab351514eb3c3274.png] 

And, for ‘SCIENCE’ is written as ‘RBHDMBD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39b63832ae4ae4306d88c73dcfd3b0c45a4c645b283afb7bb23a83199ba8d5fe.png] 

Similarly, for 'TYPEWRITER'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9454ffa01488c45a7c3f2ef2282dddc378c093a113f5faf9628a4ef21acf7b91.png] 

So, 'TYPEWRITER' will be written as 'SXODVQHSDQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
